report.summary: All four failures share one root cause: the app's list_books function sleeps a random 0–8 seconds on every /books render (app/main.py:150), and the UI tests run with a 5-second timeout, so any page load that draws a delay over 5 seconds fails. Fix this first by removing or deterministically controlling the artificial delay in app/main.py, since it makes the UI suite flaky regardless of the tests.

causes.title: Random 0–8 s delay in list_books makes every /books page load race the 5 s timeout
causes.explanation: list_books calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. render_books calls list_books on every /books render, so each page load to /books takes between 0 and 8 seconds at random. The UI fixture sets the default Playwright timeout to 5000 ms (tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7), so a load that draws more than about 5 seconds times out. That happens roughly 3/8 of the time per load, so the same code can pass on a rerun. The register test fails through the same path: a successful POST /register redirects to /books (app/main.py:297, logged_in_redirect), and the click waits for that navigation, which includes the random delay. The app is only sometimes slow, so per the triage rules this is flaky, not a product bug. The underlying cause is the injected delay in the application code. The four failing tests are not wrong about behavior, but they cannot be reliable while it exists.
evidence: app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]) (called from render_books on every /books render)
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: page.set_default_timeout(5000) with comment 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s'

tests/support/pages.py:34: self.page.goto("/books") raised playwright TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63002/books", waiting until "load" (test_deleted_book_disappears)

tests/support/pages.py:34 / tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:39 and tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:37: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded on /books (test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input, test_log_out_ends_the_session)

tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9 -> tests/support/pages.py:22: Locator.click on submit timed out with 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' (test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf); the post-register redirect goes to /books, which runs list_books
Only app/main.py and tests/conftest.py contain 'sleep'/'random' calls; no other delay in the code path.
Limitation: the run output shows timeouts only, not per-request timing, so the random-delay mechanism is inferred from the code rather than observed in this run's logs.
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py, or gate it behind an explicit setting that is off by default and never used in the UI test run. If latency needs testing, make it a fixed, opt-in delay in a dedicated test. Do not just raise the 5 s timeout in conftest, since that hides the slowness and a real 8 s load would still fail. After the fix, rerun the ui suite several times to confirm the four tests pass consistently.
